items.label: Pfizer Morgan Stanley conference 2026 (09-14-2026)
items.signal_prefix: CEO Albert Bourla on business development: in the last three

set.signal: CEO Albert Bourla on business development: Pfizer's business-development investment of the last three years went mostly into three deals - Seagen (a platform rather than a product, with intellectual property, know-how, people, labs and research projects; doing ahead of expectations every quarter), Biohaven with NURTEC ODT (doing very well and contributing significantly to growth) and Metsera - and the focus now is on maximizing the value of these investments.

items.reason: The $80 billion total and the 80% share are aggregated acquisition prices (deal prices stay out, skill section 2); the operating view stays.
items.evidence: We have invested close to $80 billion, of which 80% it is in three business deals ... we bought a platform, Seagen, which was the most expensive of that.
